notes: Standard Shopify Dawn theme. Only 2 products currently listed in this collection (small/likely under-stocked catalog) - both fit on one page, no pagination controls present. Each product card has a quick-add button containing a `.sold-out-message` span with text 'Loppuunmyyty', but it always carries a `hidden` class with computed display:none for both sampled products (Dawn theme toggles this via JS per-variant on interaction, not reliably present in static/initial HTML) - in_stock left null since listing-page stock cannot be trusted without executing the variant-selection JS. Price uses standard Dawn markup: .price__container has .price__regular (base price) and .price__sale (shown when discounted) - use .price-item--regular under .price__regular for the standard price, or .price-item--sale if a sale is active.
